principle: Hard gates are evaluated first and cannot be overridden by the weighted score. Scores are computed in code; the LLM only explains them.
hard_gates: Every mandatory pre-qualification criterion (requirement_gold category eligibility/experience/certification/commercial/legal with hard_gate=true in eligibility_gold).

factor_definitions.strategic_fit: Match of tender scope and buyer type with Nimbus core services and target sectors (0-100). DC/DR/NOC O&M for a state government = 85.
factor_definitions.technical_capability: Estimated technical evaluation score out of 100: objective marks computed from facts (T1-T5) + labelled assumptions for subjective marks (T6-T8).
factor_definitions.eligibility_confidence: Mean of eligibility_confidence_values over hard-gate items x 100.
factor_definitions.commercial_risk: 100 minus risk_deductions per clause verdict from risk_positions.json comparison.
factor_definitions.delivery_capacity: Availability of proposed key personnel and ability to staff Table 6.10 by the takeover date (0-100).

recommendation_logic: If any hard gate = gap -> NO_BID (human may override only per KB-LEG-002: MD & CEO with documented mitigation that closes the gap before submission).
Else if score >= 70 -> BID, downgraded to BID_WITH_CONDITIONS when any deal-breaker clause needs approval or any hard gate needs an action.

human_override.hard_gate_override: only with mitigation evidence; logged as exception

assumptions_disclosure: Weights and factor values are demo policy choices, not calibrated on historical win rates.
